title: Pro-finder reports a theft, it does not prevent one
body_md: Like any tracking system, Pro-finder can only report a theft or an attempted theft; it cannot prevent one. Continue to act carefully: never leave valuables in sight or easily accessible in the vehicle, and always lock the vehicle when you leave it. The manufacturer accepts no liability for stolen valuables, for theft of the vehicle, or for damage caused by burglary.
